entries.zh: 只管玩耍、以嬉戏作乐；乐于做某事
entries.en: to do nothing but play; to delight in doing something
to be glad with cheerful countenance; to rejoice in contentment
to rejoice, to be joyful
to play, to amuse oneself
to rest and take one's pleasure; to be merry and at ease
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字疑'慨/快'，依对音 khuà-/kuài- 定为'快活/快悦'。

entries.en: to rejoice ascending together to heaven; to enjoy heavenly bliss
entries.notes: R 栏为西语旁注'goamar en la cielo'（当为 gozar en el cielo）而非官话对音，M 栏中字调号污损（T99）；依义定为升天同乐。

entries.en: to leap for joy, to exult
to play, to frolic; to idle in sport
entries.notes: 汉字栏'頑'疑作'胱'，依对音 guân- 从'頑耍'。

entries.en: to be delighted, to rejoice
amusement, recreation; to make merry
to be merry and carefree; to live at ease

entries.zh: 舞狮作乐（打狮弄狮，节庆舞狮庆贺）
entries.en: to celebrate with the lion dance, to frolic with dancing
entries.notes: 汉字栏'獅'疑作'御'；西语 procua 未明（或为节庆游行一类词），依 H/M 打狮弄狮定为舞狮作乐。

entries.en: to loaf about, to be dissolute; lazy devils
entries.notes: M/R 两栏均有调号污损（T99），R 栏'tayamunso'不可解；仅依西语 holgazán dyabos 与汉字'蕩'定游荡义。

entries.zh: 戇懒呆钝；游手好闲之人
entries.en: dull-witted and lazy; an idle person
entries.notes: 汉字栏'驗'疑作'戇'，依音与西语 holgazán 定戇惰义。

entries.zh: 闲游乐人（樂人）；或指乐师
entries.en: idler, person of leisure; also a musician
to leap and frisk about; restless frolicking
entries.notes: 汉字栏'範'疑作'汎'，依对音暂定为'跳泛'一类蹦跳义。

entries.en: rice weevil, grain-boring worm
entries.notes: 汉字栏'蠹'疑作'蟲'，蛀米之虫义不变。

entries.zh: 骚客（诗人墨客）；游冶文人
entries.en: poet, versifier; idle man of letters

entries.zh: 东倚西靠；懒散倚靠无所事事
entries.en: to lean lazily now east now west; to loaf about

entries.zh: 问安语：（向您）问好、愿君安好
entries.en: greeting formula: good health to you, Your Worship; to wish you well
entries.notes: 西语句'Huelgometenga Vm. La lua.'残乱（La lua 或为 la luna），Vm=Vuestra Merced 依惯例展开；依对音 guān-lū-hò 定为'愿汝好'问候语。
